title: WheelDeck state message
description: Continuous steering and pedal state sent on every sensor or touch update. Latest value wins; no acknowledgment required.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number used to detect and discard out-of-order packets.

steering.description: Steering angle normalized to -1.0..1.0, where 0 is centered.

accelerator.description: Accelerator pedal pressure, 0.0 at rest to 1.0 fully pressed.

brake.description: Brake pedal pressure, 0.0 at rest to 1.0 fully pressed.

clutch.description: Clutch pedal pressure, 0.0 at rest to 1.0 fully pressed.
